title: Billing standing: derive good, restricted, cancelled and deleted per line and apply it in authorize
description: Ryan's revised rule (2026-11-08). Standing is derived from the ledger and the line, never stored by hand: restricted when an invoice covering the line has a balance above zero 14 days past due; cancelled when the line ends by cancellation (deleteAfter = end + 30 days); deleted once the product confirms deletion. authorize and the account directory include standing; restricted and cancelled withhold write capabilities and keep read and export. Billing never writes the account document. Publishes billing.standing_changed and deployment.deletion_due through kanbus-6efecd; time-based events come from the daily billing check. Spec: features/billing-standing.feature; model: docs/BILLING.md 'Billing standing and access'. Open questions (admin hold, warnings, reopening, invoiced mode) need Ryan before building.
